scope: Hookability attempts for MoE-class models currently available on the PC and GX10. Runtime GGUF/Ollama/vLLM targets are recorded as engine-hook candidates when they run MoE inference, not as completed semantic hook successes.
honesty_boundary: Synthetic hook smoke proves the probe pipeline only.
Stock Ollama, GGUF, llama.cpp, and OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoints do not expose Python forward hooks.
llama.cpp/Ollama MoE targets are still hookable at the inference-engine level, but need an engine patch, fork, or explicit telemetry callback before they produce semantic route artifacts.

A real-model semantic hook success requires a local Transformers/PyTorch MoE runtime, a compatible Python environment, nonzero hook_count, nonempty router_events.jsonl, and summary router_event_count greater than zero.

gx10.notes: GX10 has one local Transformers-style MoE target, but the available hook image lacks Nemotron trusted-code dependencies.
